shaarei-teshuvah/2:_.en: In Shulchan Aruch: even though it is written, etc. — and see in Taz that one does not sanctify the levanah before Shabbat Nachamu, etc.; and we practice as written in siman 506 in the name of the Ari, may his memory be for a blessing, to sanctify on the motza'ei of the 9th of Av; and see in Shevut Yaakov part 2 siman 11 that he would taste something beforehand, and I brought it in my responsum there; and see below in Magen Avraham siman 551 s.k. 25 who wrote 'to flesh the levanah,' etc.; and in Be'er Heitev siman 559 it is written 'to flesh the Divine Presence called levanah,' etc.; and see in Darkei Moshe in the name of Maharil: one who forgot and ate on the 10th of Tevet must fast on the 11th; and Avnei Nezer wrote it is obvious that on the 10th of Tevet itself he must complete after he remembers. In the selichot for the 17th of Tammuz: 'she took in her sin in her head and in a chain' — this is a printing error and it should read 'and in double' with a pei, and it is as the verse explains, for she received from the hand of Hashem double for all her sin; and the explanation of the word 'in her head' is the horn, as is written 'and he returned his guilt upon his head' — see there.

turei-zahav/1:_.he: בטור מביא ל' הגמ' צום השביעי זה ג' בתשרי שבו נהרג גדליה ולמה נכתב כאן ללמדך ששקולה מיתת הצדיקים כשריפת בית אלהינו זה צריך ביאור דמה קשה לו על מ"ש כאן דהא סיים בכאן שחשיב כסדר החדשים אע"פ שלענין הזמן הזה צום העשירי קודם למה דחשיב הפורעניות תחלה א"כ בצום השביעי נמי נימ' הכי ונראה דצום העשירי הוא עכ"ם זכר לחורבן הבית שבאותו יום התחיל כת האויב ע"כ חשיב כל מה דמרמז לחורבן ע"פ סדר חדשים משא"כ בצ"ג שהוא ענין מיתת צדיקים ואין בו רמז חורבן ק' למה חשבו בין המרמזי' על החורבן ותי' ללמדך כו' הב"י הביא דברי רי"ו וז"ל ג' בתשרי שבו נהרג גדליה אמרו בר"ה נהרג ונדחה תעניתו ליום חול עכ"ל ולפ"ז היה נראה דאם יש מילה בצ"ג דאין בעל הברית מתענ' עד הליל' כמ"ש בסי' תקנ"ט בעל ברית אינו משלים בט"ב שחל בשבת ונדחה ליום א' לפי שי"ט שלו הוא ה"נ נימ' כן בצ"ג וי"ל דשאני התם דנרא' לכל הדחיי' בזמנינו דאנו רואים שעיקר התענית של ט"ב חל בשבת אלא שנדח' ע"כ נשתנ' דינו משא"כ בצ"ג דפעם הראשון דחוהו וגזרו להתענות ביום ג' לעולם חל הגזירה לעולם בשוה ואין נראה לנו הדחייה:
turei-zahav/1:_.en: In the Tur he cites the language of the Gemara: the fast of the seventh — this is the 3rd of Tishrei on which Gedaliah was killed; and why is it written here 'to teach you that the death of the righteous is equivalent to the burning of the House of our Hashem' — this needs explanation, for what is difficult for him on what is written here, that he concluded here that he counts in the order of the months even though for this time the fast of the tenth precedes — why he counts the calamities first; if so, on the fast of the seventh one should also say so? And it appears the fast of the tenth is a remembrance for the non-Jews of the destruction of the House, for on that day the enemy began to write — therefore he counts everything that alludes to destruction in the order of the months; unlike the fast of the seventh which is the matter of the death of the righteous and has no allusion to destruction — why did he count it among the allusions to destruction? And one may explain 'to teach you,' etc. — the Beit Yosef brought the words of Rabbeinu Yeruham, and this is his language: on the 3rd of Tishrei on which Gedaliah was killed they said he was killed on Rosh Hashana and his fast was deferred to a weekday — up to here; and therefore it would seem that if there is a rule in the fast of the seventh that a ba'al berit does not fast until night, as is written in siman 559, a ba'al berit does not complete on the 9th of Av when it falls on Shabbat and is deferred to Sunday because his Yom Tov is then — one should likewise say on the fast of the seventh; and one may say it is different there, for the deferral is evident to all in our times, for we see the main fast of the 9th of Av falls on Shabbat but is deferred — therefore its law changed; unlike the fast of the seventh where the first time they deferred it they decreed to fast on the 3rd forever — the decree applies forever equally and the deferral is not evident to us.

yad-ephraim/1:_.he: בש"ע סעיף א' חייבים להתענות בת"ב נקט ט"ב ברישא משום דחמירא ליה ואעפ"י שאינו לסדר חדשים ולא לסדר פורעניות:
yad-ephraim/1:_.en: In the words of Article A, the U.S.A. must be prepared for the purpose of not having a new order and not a formal order:
